entries.name: skin
entries.summary: Root container for global resources and screen definitions.

entries.name: screen
entries.summary: Register a screen definition selected by its Python screen class.

attributes.name: Screen name matched by the class skinName; case-sensitive.
attributes.id: Output ID: 0 normally means the TV OSD; displays use their own IDs.
attributes.position: x,y or center,center in the design coordinate system.
attributes.resolution: width,height of the design coordinate system.
attributes.title: Translated window title.
attributes.flags: Comma-separated window flags, for example wfNoBorder.
attributes.ignoreWidgets: Comma-separated optional Python widget names excluded from missing-widget warnings.

entries.example:
<screen name="ExampleScreen" position="center,center" size="600,400" resolution="1920,1080" title="Example">
  <eLabel position="20,20" size="560,60" font="Regular;28" text="Hello" />
</screen>
notes: The screen must be opened by Python; a skin file does not create a menu entry. Visual attributes are listed under eWindow.

entries.name: widget
entries.summary: Bind an existing component, connect a renderer to a source, or instantiate an addon.

attributes.name: Existing GUI component name; use the name declared by the screen.
attributes.source: Existing source name, optionally a supported related-screen path.
attributes.render: Renderer module/class name, for example Label or Listbox.
attributes.addon: Addon class, for example ScreenHeader. Its own connection and attribute contract applies.
attributes.connection: Comma-separated existing component names required by the addon.

notes: The example requires a source description exposing text. Use the component, source/renderer or addon form as appropriate; these do not create missing sources.

entries.name: convert
entries.summary: Transform a source before the renderer consumes it.

attributes.type: Converter module/class name. Arguments belong in element text, not generic widget attributes.

entries.example:
<widget source="global.CurrentTime" render="Label" position="20,20" size="300,60" font="Regular;28">
  <convert type="ClockToText">WithSeconds</convert>
</widget>
notes: Converter arguments are class-specific. Consult the converter reference for their separators and accepted options.

entries.name: eLabel / ePixmap / eRectangle
entries.summary: Create decorative native widgets without a Python GUI component.
notes: Use the native-widget reference for additional attributes. eRectangle uses backgroundColor for its fill.

entries.name: panel
entries.summary: Include a named screen/panel definition or arrange child widgets in a local layout context.

attributes.name: Optional existing screen/panel definition to include.
attributes.position: x,y, fill or an edge docking position supported by the current layout.
attributes.spacing: Integer gap used by the layout context.
attributes.font: Optional font alias/face for character-relative layout metrics.

entries.example:
<panel position="20,20" size="560,100" layout="horizontal" spacing="8">
  <eLabel position="left" size="200,60" font="Regular;28" text="Left" />
</panel>
notes: Screen panels and panels inside list templates use different parsers.

entries.name: eStack
entries.summary: Create a native stack container for its child widgets.
entries.example:
<eStack position="20,20" size="560,100" layout="horizontal" spacing="8">
  <eLabel position="left" size="200,60" font="Regular;28" text="Item" />
</eStack>
notes: Do not confuse the eStack element with the no-op stack attribute.

entries.name: output / resolution
entries.summary: Set the GUI output resolution.

attributes.id: On output: output ID; omitted means GUI ID 0.
attributes.xres: On resolution: horizontal pixels; loader fallback 720.
attributes.yres: On resolution: vertical pixels; loader fallback 576.
attributes.bpp: On resolution: bits per pixel, normally 32; non-32-bit palette loading is not implemented here.

entries.name: include
entries.summary: Load another skin resource file.

attributes.filename: Existing file resolved in the current skin path/scope.
attributes.conditional: Optional Python expression evaluated by the loader. Omit for unconditional inclusion.

notes: This conditional is an expression, unlike conditional on an ordinary screen child, which tests component names.

entries.name: colors / color
entries.summary: Register named colours or gradients for supported parsers.

attributes.name: On color: alias name.
attributes.value: On color: #AARRGGBB or a named colour; a comma-containing value registers a gradient string.

notes: AA is transparency: 00 opaque, FF transparent. Use the gradient only in attributes supporting gradients.

entries.name: fonts / font
entries.summary: Register an existing font file under a face name.

attributes.filename: Existing font file resolved through the font/skin path.
attributes.name: Registered face name; loader fallback Regular.
attributes.render: Integer native font-render option; default 0. Leave it at 0 unless your font requires another supported native mode.

notes: Replace myfont.ttf with an installed/bundled font. This font element is different from a widget font="Face;size" attribute.

entries.name: fonts / alias
entries.summary: Give a font and layout metrics a reusable alias.
notes: width and height are layout metrics, not measurements of each displayed string.

entries.name: parameters / parameter
entries.summary: Supply named values consumed by Python components.

attributes.name: Exact parameter key expected by the component.
attributes.value: Comma-separated typed values: integer, float, 0xHEX, #AARRGGBB, registered colour, Face;size, or *text for a string.

notes: The key and tuple shape are component-specific. This example controls configuration slider height and border width.

entries.name: variables / variable
entries.summary: Register a coordinate pair used by parsers supporting variable substitution.

attributes.name: Variable name.
attributes.value: Exactly two comma-separated coordinate strings in this loader.

notes: Not a general XML macro. Use only in parsers that consult the variables table.

entries.name: switchpixmap / pixmap
entries.summary: Register a named, preloaded image.

attributes.name: Pixmap identifier.
attributes.filename: Existing image file resolved in the skin scope.

entries.name: windowstyle
entries.summary: Supply defaults shared by widgets using a window style.

attributes.id: Window style ID; omitted means GUI ID 0.

entries.example:
<windowstyle id="0">
  <label font="Regular;28" />
  <listbox font="Regular;24" scrollbarMode="showOnDemand" scrollbarWidth="12" scrollbarOffset="4" />
  <configList entryFont="Regular;24" valueFont="Regular;24" headerFont="Regular;26" />
</windowstyle>
notes: Global defaults are not identical to per-widget attribute parsing. Some listbox defaults affect global native state.

entries.name: configList
entries.summary: Configure default configuration-label/value/header fonts and offsets.

attributes.readOnlyColor: Colour for read-only configuration entries; global, last loaded setting wins.
attributes.entryFontScale: Recognised by the loader, but the pinned branch refers to style.guiObject. No working example is claimed for this path.

entries.example: <configList entryFont="Regular;24" valueFont="Regular;24" headerFont="Regular;26" entryLeftOffset="15" headerLeftOffset="15" indentSize="20" />

entries.name: listbox / scrolllabel
entries.summary: Set shared list and scrolling-label defaults.

attributes.font: listbox only: default list font, fallback Regular;20.
attributes.horizontalAlignment: listbox only: default text alignment left/center/right/block.
attributes.scrollbarMode: Native mode token; ScrollLabel later applies its own supported modes.

notes: These are global defaults, parsed without per-screen scaling here. Explicit widget attributes can override them.

entries.name: label / title / slider / stringList
entries.summary: Set other native style defaults.

attributes.offset: On title: x,y title offset; fallback 20,5.
attributes.borderWidth: On slider: integer default border width.
attributes.textPadding: On stringList: one/two/four padding integers. This context still uses textPadding; do not rename it to padding solely because the central widget alias is deprecated.

entries.name: margin
entries.summary: Set margins on the selected desktop.

attributes.id: Desktop ID, normally 0 for the TV GUI.

entries.name: templates / template
entries.summary: Define list row drawing operations for XmlMultiContent.

attributes.name: Template selector, normally Default; matches List.template.
attributes.fonts: Comma-separated Face;size entries; child font indexes start at 0.
attributes.itemWidth: Row width; when absent the surrounding widget width is used.
attributes.itemHeight: Row height; supply a positive value.
attributes.component: For external modern service-list templates: serviceList. This is not a generic XmlMultiContent selector.

entries.example:
<widget source="list" render="Listbox" position="20,20" size="600,280">
  <template name="Default" fonts="Regular;28" itemHeight="70">
    <text index="0" position="0,0" size="600,70" font="0" />
  </template>
</widget>
notes: Requires a List source called list, with text at tuple index 0. The loader inserts XmlMultiContent automatically. Unknown template attributes only have an effect when the owning component reads them.

entries.name: mode / rowtemplate
entries.summary: Choose a whole-list style or a per-row drawing variant.

attributes.name: On mode: style selector, normally default; matches List.style.

entries.example:
<mode name="default" itemHeight="50">
  <text index="0" position="0,0" size="600,50" font="0" />
</mode>
notes: For rowtemplate variants, XML order gives the numeric selector used in tuple field 0. Rowtemplates share the template row size; no per-row itemHeight override.

entries.name: text
entries.summary: Draw a text field from the row tuple, or static text.

attributes.index: Tuple number or an indexNames key supplied by the component; omit for static text.
attributes.text: Static text when no row index is selected.
attributes.position: x,y inside the row or template panel.
attributes.font: Zero-based integer index into the template fonts table; not Face;size.
attributes.flags: Comma-separated blend, underline, scroll. Underlining here uses flags="underline".
attributes.padding: One/two/four values in left,top,right,bottom order; generic XmlMultiContent scales the padding.
attributes.foregroundColor: Normal text colour; generic named-index lists can use +FieldName.
attributes.format: Recorded by XmlMultiContent, but only effective if the owning screen consumes templateDataFormats.
attributes.conditional: Construction-time expression in the template parser; not a live visibility binding.

entries.example: <text index="0" position="0,0" size="600,70" font="0" flags="underline" horizontalAlignment="left" />
notes: Field availability belongs to the owner. Named service-list fields and network fields are different contracts.

entries.name: pixmap
entries.summary: Draw a row pixmap or a static image.

attributes.index: Row field index/name containing the image data expected by this builder.
attributes.pixmap: Static image when no row index is selected.
attributes.alpha: blend, test, or omitted for ordinary pixmap drawing. This is not alphaTest.
attributes.scale: Pixmap scaling token, for example centerScaled.
attributes.padding: One/two/four inset values for generic XmlMultiContent.
attributes.cornerRadius: radius[;edges] where the drawing operation supports it.

notes: Replace the image with an existing asset. A field storing an icon-font glyph is text, not a pixmap.

entries.name: rectangle / progress
entries.summary: Draw row decorations or progress values.

attributes.index: For progress: row data field containing the progress value.
attributes.foregroundColor: Progress fill; also rectangle fill in the specialised service-list builder.
attributes.borderColorSelected: Selected outline colour where supported by the chosen operation.
attributes.foregroundGradient: start[,middle],end,direction[,alphaBlend]. Current template field; do not migrate it as if it were the central deprecated attribute.

notes: This example is for generic XmlMultiContent. ServiceListTemplateParser uses foregroundColor for a rectangle fill; inspect the owner before copying.

entries.name: panel
entries.summary: Arrange row drawing items in a local layout context.

attributes.position: Local x,y, fill or an edge placement supported by the template context.
attributes.autoGrow: On a child item in a horizontal panel: any non-empty string requests leftover width for the first matching item. Omit to disable; the string "0" is non-empty and therefore does not disable it.

entries.example:
<panel position="0,0" size="600,50" layout="horizontal" spacing="10">
  <text index="0" position="left" size="180,50" font="0" />
  <text index="1" position="left" size="400,50" font="0" />
</panel>
notes: autoGrow is parsed during layout and is not the scrollbar shrink option. No autoGrow rendering example is claimed for this snapshot.

entries.name: constant-widgets / constant-widget / layouts / layout
entries.context: Skin root and references inside screens
entries.summary: Register reusable widget groups and insert them by name.

attributes.name: On constant-widget/layout: definition name; the same name selects it from a screen reference.

entries.example:
<skin>
  <layouts>
    <layout name="ExampleHeading">
      <eLabel position="20,20" size="560,60" font="Regular;28" text="Heading" />
    </layout>
  </layouts>
  <screen name="ExampleScreen" position="center,center" size="600,400">
    <layout name="ExampleHeading" />
  </screen>
</skin>
notes: The layout element is a named resource reference; layout="horizontal" on a panel is a separate attribute.

entries.name: screens / menus / setups
entries.summary: Map screen, menu or setup keys to images consumed by the UI.

attributes.key: On screen/menu/setup: one exact key requested by the consuming component.
attributes.keys: On screen/menu/setup: comma-separated keys; used instead of key when supplied.
attributes.image: Image path read by the consuming UI component.

notes: Use a key that the target UI actually requests and an existing asset. This does not add a new menu or setup screen.

entries.name: color
entries.summary: Set a named native style colour.

attributes.name: Native colour role without the col prefix, for example Background, Foreground or ListboxBackgroundSelected.
attributes.color: Registered colour or #AARRGGBB. Unlike colors/color this attribute is named color, not value.

notes: Native roles include Background, Foreground, ListboxBackground, ListboxForeground, ListboxBackgroundSelected, ListboxForegroundSelected, ListboxBackgroundMarked, ListboxForegroundMarked, ListboxBackgroundMarkedSelected, ListboxForegroundMarkedSelected, WindowTitleForeground, WindowTitleBackground, ScrollbarForeground, ScrollbarBackground, ScrollbarBorder, SliderForeground, SliderBackground and SliderBorder.

entries.name: borderset / pixmap
entries.summary: Assign image pieces to a native window, button or list-entry border.

attributes.name: On borderset: bsWindow, bsButton or bsListboxEntry.
attributes.pos: On pixmap: bpTopLeft, bpTop, bpTopRight, bpLeft, bpBackground, bpRight, bpBottomLeft, bpBottom or bpBottomRight.
attributes.filename: Existing image file for that border piece.

notes: Replace the asset path and supply the pieces needed by your design.

entries.name: subtitles / sub
entries.summary: Configure native subtitle font and outline styles.

attributes.name: Existing eSubtitleWidget face name, such as Subtitle_Regular.
attributes.foregroundColor: Optional forced text colour; omitted means no forced colour.
attributes.shadowColor: Legacy fallback used when borderColor is absent in this subtitle context.

notes: This affects the native subtitle style, not a normal label. Subtitle rendering may also depend on the subtitle format and receiver settings.

entries.name: applet
entries.summary: Attach trusted Python code to a screen callback.

attributes.type: onLayoutFinish or onContentChanged; the element body contains Python code.

notes: A skin applet executes code on the receiver. Keep ordinary appearance in XML attributes; this example only demonstrates callback placement.

entries.name: foregroundColorMarked / foregroundColorMarkedAndSelected / backgroundColorMarked / backgroundColorMarkedAndSelected
entries.summary: Choose colours for marked services and for a service that is marked and selected.

attributes.foregroundColorMarkedAndSelected: Text/foreground colour when marked and selected.

notes: This is a serviceList template field, not a generic XmlMultiContent tuple index or an ordinary widget attribute.
